items.text:
Great foundation, but 1.0 still feels unpolished at its core.
I love the core concept of the game, but the 1.0 release still suffers from severe QoL, performance, and UI issues that ruin the experience:

    Stuttering / Performance: Once I operate a mid-sized ship, running the game at 4x speed or higher causes constant stuttering. It gets significantly worse when assigning multiple tasks to the crew.

    Lack of Information: When work stops, the game gives zero feedback on why (missing parts, dead battery, or personal needs/morale issue). Having to manually check every single variable is extremely tedious.

    Clunky Autotasks & AI:
        During auto-repairs, crew members carry loose parts one by one instead of using their backpacks. Is this intentional?
        I can't assign crew to specialized roles (e.g., dedicated EVA worker vs. interior repairperson).
        Zones are also restrictive and frustrating because they cannot overlap.

    Bugs: Critical features randomly break. For example, my airlock doors suddenly stopped responding to electrical signals for no reason. It works when I restart with previous savefile. I have to role-back several times. And why I see the bug information when I reload savefile?

    Frustrating UI & Fixed Keybindings: Awkward quick-button assignments (like fixed hotkeys causing you to accidentally bash floors) combined with frame stuttering lead to constant, maddening misclicks.

Verdict:
The game itself is good and I really want to enjoy it, but these friction points make playing it exhausting right now. I’ll come back after a few more patches.

-----------------

After another full 3 more days:
I accept the concepts. AI is dull, so I do smart. Now I'm carrying crate-of-parts for repairing. Also prepare Autotask step-by-step. Now my hand can expect quick action and press it without misclicks. Most of information are etched. Still improvement is needed, but now I change my mind. Most of them are by design. At least, I accept. Anyway, scavenging is fun.
items.text_zh:
基础很棒，但1.0在核心上仍然感觉未经打磨。
我喜欢这游戏的核心概念，但1.0版本仍然饱受严重的QoL、性能和UI问题困扰，毁了游戏体验：

    卡顿/性能：一旦我操作一艘中型飞船，以4倍速或更高速度运行游戏就会导致持续卡顿。当给船员分配多项任务时，情况会明显恶化。

    信息缺失：当工作停止时，游戏完全不反馈原因（缺少零件、电池没电，还是个人需求/士气问题）。必须手动检查每一个变量极其繁琐。

    笨拙的自动任务与AI：
        在自动维修期间，船员们会一件一件地搬运散装零件，而不是使用他们的背包。这是故意的吗？
        我无法将船员分配到专门的角色（例如，专职EVA工人与内部维修人员）。
        区域也很受限且令人沮丧，因为它们不能重叠。

    Bug：关键功能会随机失效。例如，我的气闸门突然毫无理由地不再响应电信号。用之前的存档重启后它又能用了。我不得不回滚好几次。而且为什么我在重新加载存档时会看到bug信息？

    令人沮丧的UI与固定按键绑定：别扭的快捷按钮分配（比如固定热键导致你意外砸地板）加上帧卡顿，导致不断出现令人抓狂的误点。

结论：
游戏本身很好，我真的很想享受它，但这些摩擦点让现在玩起来很累。等再过几个补丁我会回来的。

-----------------

又过了整整3天之后：
我接受了这些概念。AI很迟钝，所以我来变聪明。现在我自己搬运一箱零件去维修。也一步步准备好自动任务。现在我的手可以预判快速操作并按下它而不会误点。大部分信息都已刻在脑子里。仍然需要改进，但现在我改变主意了。它们大多是设计使然。至少，我接受了。不管怎样，拾荒很有趣。
